description: Dreadnaught Bracers Level 60 Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Bracers if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Bracers, 6 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 1 Nexus Crystal. Requirements: - Desecrated Bracers - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 6 - Arcanite Bar - Nexus Crystal
